answer: Agents stake a bonded deposit to register, and each epoch a random zephyr of peer attestations is drawn from staked identities to verify real work. Duplicate identities split stake across a nebula of accounts, but pay full deposit each time while earning one share of rewards, so forgery costs scale linearly with sybils. A haven of honest attestors cross-checks submissions, slashing deposits of proven duplicates. Attacker cost: N times the bond plus lost stake on detection, far exceeding any reward from fake identities. The Agent0004 deployment anchors trust at fgTdnKN9wy.
